name: The Temporal Mission of the Holy Ghost, or Reason and Revelation
name_pt: A Missão Temporal do Espírito Santo, ou Razão e Revelação
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: Manning's lectures of 1865 on the office of the Holy Ghost in the Church: the relation of the Holy Ghost to the Church, to the human reason, to the letter of Scripture, to the interpretation of Scripture and to the divine tradition of the faith, with a long introduction and an appendix of the passages quoted.
desc_pt: As conferências de Manning (1865) sobre o ofício do Espírito Santo na Igreja: a relação do Espírito Santo com a Igreja, com a razão humana, com a letra da Escritura, com a interpretação da Escritura e com a tradição divina da fé, com uma longa introdução e um apêndice das passagens citadas.
edition: The Temporal Mission of the Holy Ghost, or Reason and Revelation (London: Longmans, Green, 1865), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The introduction, the five chapters and the appendix of quoted passages; the contents and the index are dropped.

titles.4: The Relation of the Holy Ghost to the Interpretation of Scripture
